scope: four frozen H67 ep35 bottleneck Conv3x3 operators only; no system, full-network, RTL-measured, resource-normalized, PPA, power, energy, or DATE-headline claim
verified: Independently decoded and rehashed 80 M40 payload files totaling 42,346,309 bytes without importing an upstream analyzer.
Recomputed all 51,840,000 source rows and all 17,280 phases from the frozen M40 positive planes plus the frozen M430 q32 catalog.
Reproduced M430 K1-separate 517,041,352 cycles and strong zero K1 742,148,386 cycles exactly.
Reproduced all six M447 cycle points, every audited per-phase field, early-matcher count, and the full PWP/fallback correction-distance histogram with zero mismatch.
Proved on the full symbolic population that selected_center plus signed residual reconstructs each original 16-bit source word with zero mismatch.
Verified the issue formulas: PWP separate=1+ceil(d/K), PWP fused=max(1,ceil(d/K)), fallback=ceil(popcount/K); every positive-residual PWP row saves exactly one issue per output block in fused mode.
Recomputed all 42,467,328 catalog PWP lanes: range [-1089,1059], zero signed12 violations.  Conservative K4 fused range is [-1601,1571], so signed13 is safe and signed12 is already sufficient.
Recomputed the frozen-weight accumulator absolute bound 218,338, which requires signed19 and is unchanged by an exact decomposition.

Verified the stated recurrence preserves old_psum: new_psum=old_psum+sum(all delta chunks).  This avoids the revoked M426 overwrite semantics, conditional on the future RTL actually accumulating every chunk.

resource_fairness.interpretation: 2.187x and 2.413x are exact trace-cycle opportunity ratios against one 96-byte/cycle correction source, but they are not resource-normalized.  K2 loses 1.13% to a floor-byte-equivalent K3 zero fold, and K4 loses even to equal-K zero.

traffic.interpretation: The 30.30% source-byte reduction belongs to the frozen M430 catalog/PWP decomposition.  M447 folding changes issue parallelism, not total correction traffic.

findings.title: The apparent >2x points are primarily unmatched-port opportunities
findings.detail: K2-fused consumes 352 bytes/cycle at a fused issue and K4-fused consumes 544 bytes/cycle, versus 96 bytes/cycle for the quoted strong-zero denominator.  Equal-K and floor-byte-equivalent zero diagnostics reduce or reverse the advantage; therefore 2.187x/2.413x cannot be admitted as hardware speedup.

findings.title: K4 is dominated before RTL and K2 lacks a resource-normalized win
findings.detail: K4-fused is 0.94192x versus equal-K4 zero and 0.85686x versus floor-byte-equivalent K5 zero.  K2-fused is 0.98884x versus floor-byte-equivalent K3 zero.  Starting K2/K4 RTL for a speed headline is NO-GO until a matched SRAM/interconnect model changes this conclusion.

findings.title: The cycle recurrence assumes the hardest physical mechanisms
findings.detail: There is no model or Synopsys evidence for K conflict-free correction reads per cycle, simultaneous PWP plus correction delivery, the 96-lane reduction/pre-adder, its pipeline latency, Fmax derating, SRAM macros, or routing.  The exact arithmetic schedule is therefore opportunity evidence only.

findings.title: The 3.4905x ideal ceiling is intentionally non-exact
findings.detail: Its 212,617,580-cycle recurrence removes fallback and residual correction work entirely.  It is an unattainable arithmetic lower bound, not an exact architectural point, and must never share a table column with the six exact points without this label.

findings.title: Signed13 is safe but not a tight frozen bound
findings.detail: The independently recomputed worst conservative K4 fused range [-1601,1571] fits signed12.  A signed13 implementation is legal but carries avoidable width unless timing/routing simplicity justifies it.

decision.preferred_admitted_point_now: RETAIN_M430_K1_SEPARATE_AND_M433; DO_NOT REPLACE IT WITH AN M447 POINT

priority.first: Price a banked equal-K zero K2/K3/K4/K5 fabric and the M430 PWP store/port under the same SRAM/interconnect assumptions.
priority.second: Only if the existing M430 PWP and correction ports can truly be read concurrently with a cheap pre-adder, implement K1 fused as the smallest incremental probe; its gain versus M430 is 1.20199x, not a >2x point.
priority.close: Do not spend the DATE critical path on K4.  Do not implement K2 merely to preserve the 2.187x denominator.
